To avoid being apprehended for embezzling funds from your job again, it is important to implement certain techniques: 
- Immediately report any issues with the bank's computer system; be prepared to provide evidence that you were within the system at the time of an inquiry; this can often be proven with screenshots saved on a personal device. 
- Refrain from logging into or attempting to access restricted systems unless you have specific authorization to do so. In addition, keep password information private and never share it with anyone at the organization.
- Do not use personal tools or accounts when accessing company data or files– use only those approved by your employer – and always log out when finished, even if you must exit suddenly. 
- Develop protocols for all financial transactions such as signing off on each transaction, double checking account balances after completion and having approval rights set up appropriately at different levels within the institution - including those who regularly process payments (such as ATM/Debit card transactions).
